_readme: Hand-resolved answers for notes the Obsidian importer cannot settle from a bare title. Copy to data/obsidian-overrides.json (or wherever ARBITER_OBSIDIAN_OVERRIDES points). Keys are the note's file name. title = the title Plex uses; query = what to search for when that differs from the title; year = asserted release year; guid = skip search and use this plex:// guid; type = re-file into another contest (movie, tv, anime, anime_movie, documentary); manual = build the row from this entry alone (no poster or ids); skip = leave the note out, with the reason.
